name: Steamed rice rolls
summary: Cao Bang bánh cuốn is a hot, soft, white rice sheet filled with pork fried with dried shallot, served in a clear pork-bone broth with giò, chả, and egg. Ask for the egg roll and an egg is cracked into the sheet while it steams.
howToEat: Eat it hot from the broth with scallion and chili pickled with mắc mật or bamboo. Fish sauce and lime are optional extras, not the usual dip.
where: Morning stalls across Cao Bang city, opening from 4 to 5 in the morning.
seoTitle: Cao Bang banh cuon — broth, not fish sauce
seoDescription: Cao Bang bánh cuốn is a hot, soft, white rice sheet filled with pork fried with dried shallot, served in a clear pork-bone broth with giò, chả, and egg..
texture: Báo Cao Bằng on 4 July 2012 says the sheet is chewy and soft. The 1 September 2026 article says the sheet is white, soft, and hot.
